eugs.question: How strongly did the selected cancer-biology replication effects replicate under multiple published criteria?
eugs.answer_statement: Across five published dichotomous criteria, reported replication success rates ranged from 25% to 63% in the analyzed sample.

source.title: Investigating the replicability of preclinical cancer biology

eugs.boundary: Study-sample only; not a universal reproducibility rate and not evidence that decentralization causes better science.

eugs.question: How much of the planned replication programme could be completed?
eugs.answer_statement: The project completed 50 of 193 planned experiments, about 26%.

source.title: Investigating the replicability of preclinical cancer biology

eugs.boundary: Project-specific completion fraction; not a universal failure rate and not causal evidence for any DeSci architecture.
